rules.topic: Do not completely cross the Center Line in AUTO
rules.reason: The extra MAJOR FOUL per contact with an opponent is not counted.

rules.topic: Launch Fuel into your Hub only while bumpers are at least partly in your Alliance Zone
rules.reason: One MAJOR FOUL per continuous launch sequence aimed at the robot's own Hub; per-instance counting in the manual is not modeled.

rules.topic: Do not eject Fuel from the field
rules.reason: A launched Fuel landing outside the field is a MINOR FOUL; escalation to MAJOR for repeats is not modeled.
Stretch goal. Pinning is simulated physically but not penalized yet.

rules.topic: Tower protection in the last 30 seconds

rules.reason: The Outpost feeder has a fixed stock capacity; no foul is assessed.

rules.topic: Do not catch Fuel released by the Hub

rules.reason: Not in v1. Robots cannot climb on each other in the sim.
